breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly requires solving the exact integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx and explicitly states 'Do not use the arithmetic-mean area for the calculation.' This directly corrects the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly replaced A(x) with its arithmetic mean and called it exact. The generated specification aligns with the ground truth, which simply specifies the integral without any arithmetic-mean approximation.
